$comment: High/critical production advisories that cannot be fixed yet. Each entry needs a reason it is unreachable or acceptable and a revisit date; scripts/audit/audit-gate.mjs fails on expired, unused or missing entries. See docs/DEPENDENCY_AUDIT.md.

advisories.reason: No patched release. The flaw is in RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification. @parallaxai/security now verifies certificates with node:crypto X509Certificate and uses node-forge only to generate keys and sign certificates, so the vulnerable verification path is not called. Replacing node-forge is planned in Phase 3.
